result.summary: The image shows a well-maintained urban crossing with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and wide, clear sidewalks. The environment is dominated by a large building overhang that creates a tunnel-like roadway section, which may impact visibility due to shadows.

hazards.name: Shadowed Underpass
hazards.description: The building overhang creates a significant shadow zone that can reduce the visibility of pedestrians to drivers as they enter or exit the tunnel area.
hazards.location_in_image: Center background where the roadway passes under the building.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: While vehicle traffic lights are present, no dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to guide safe crossing intervals.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles on the left and right sides of the foreground crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Enhanced Underpass Lighting
interventions.description: Improve lighting levels within the tunnel section to ensure pedestrians are clearly visible to motorists at all times of day.

interventions.title: In-Street Pedestrian Crossing Sign
interventions.description: Place a 'Yield to Pedestrians' sign in the center of the roadway to increase driver awareness at the crosswalk.

result.summary: The street features wide, well-maintained sidewalks and a clearly marked zebra crosswalk in an urban mixed-use setting. However, the crossing distance is significant and sightlines are hindered by on-street parking near the intersection.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk limit the visibility between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street near the foreground crosswalk.

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the width of the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crossing to reduce the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and wide, well-maintained sidewalks with tactile curb ramps. The environment is a dense urban setting with clear lane markings and street lighting, though it lacks physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Turning vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles turning from the cross-street may conflict with pedestrians in the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively fast vehicle turns compared to a tighter radius.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a multi-lane one-way urban street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the wide roadway and parked vehicles near the crossing create visibility and exposure risks.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the left side of the street obstruct the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, upstream of the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of one-way traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, across the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
